timeline.summary: Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹158.52 Cr, net profit ₹22.06 Cr.
Fabtech Technologies filed its statement of deviation or variation showing no deviation in IPO fund utilization for Q4FY26.

Fabtech Technologies Limited hosted an earnings conference call on April 28, 2026, at 10:00 a.m. (IST) for audited standalone and consolidated financial results for Q4FY26 and FY26, chaired by Executive Director Hemant Mohan Anavkar.
Fabtech Technologies reported FY26 total income of ₹431.33 Cr and net profit of ₹38.36 Cr, backed by an order book exceeding ₹900 Cr.
Fabtech Technologies filed its Monitoring Agency Report for Q4 FY26 on May 07, 2026, reporting ₹51.08 Cr utilization of IPO proceeds.
Fabtech Technologies announced board changes including appointment of independent directors and senior management transitions on May 25, 2026.
Fabtech Technologies signed a shareholders agreement to form a 51%-owned step-down subsidiary in Saudi Arabia for non-pharma specialized contracting.
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹92.09 Cr (-24.2% YoY), net profit ₹15.02 Cr (-46.6% YoY).
Fabtech Technologies filed its statement of deviation or variation for IPO fund utilization for Q2 FY27 on October 28, 2026.
Fabtech Technologies Limited shared the recording of its earnings conference call on October 30, 2026, discussing unaudited Q2 & H1 FY2027 results via the provided link.
